name: Bamboo worms
summary: A name on the culture director’s list in Vietnam News. The article prints no Vietnamese name and no method. It does not say these are sâu chít. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Nguyễn Minh Phú, director of the culture department, is quoted by Vietnam News on 28 Apr 2024. The name stays in English because no Vietnamese name was printed.
howToEat: Vietnam News names bamboo worms among the province’s specialities and does not describe them. A method and a price are Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Sâu chít is another name, and Vietnam News did not link the two. Check on arrival.
